scripts.dev:backend: bash -c 'if [ -f .venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then .venv/bin/uvicorn weatherwise.main:app --reload --port 8000; else uvicorn weatherwise.main:app --reload --port 8000; fi'
scripts.lint:backend: bash -c 'if [ -f .venv/bin/ruff ]; then .venv/bin/ruff check .; else ruff check .; fi'
scripts.cli: bash -c 'if [ -f .venv/bin/weatherwise ]; then .venv/bin/weatherwise "$@"; else python3 -m weatherwise "$@"; fi' --
